dct_title_s: Greece - Wildfire in Trapezitsa Mountain, Greece (EMSR929)
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR929. On August 31, 2026, at 16.00 UTC, in Trapezitsa Mountain, near the city of Konitsa, Ipirus Region, Greece, a fire started due to a lightning, which mainly burned underground. In this moment the fire is ongoing, burning a forest of black pine. A large number of firefighters and aerial means are used for the fire suppression, assisted by municipality vehicles/machinery and volunteer organizations. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, fire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping. **Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR929 **Product types present in this dataset's resources:** **DEL (Delineation)**: maps the extent of the event itself (eg. flood, fire, landslide boundary). Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
